subject.title: fix(gateway): report failed OpenAI streams instead of false success

question: Does the Gateway owner approve the proposed OpenAI-compatible terminal failure framing after reviewing direct after-fix evidence from a real lifecycle-failure stream?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and externally observable protocol-terminal semantics require an explicit owner decision even though the patch is narrowly scoped.

options.title: Approve after direct failure proof
options.body: Accept the sticky lifecycle-failure behavior once a redacted Gateway transcript shows both endpoint families terminate as proposed.

options.title: Request alternate protocol framing
options.body: Keep the bug fix open if Gateway owners require a different error payload, usage policy, or terminal ordering for compatibility.

recommendation.title: Approve after direct failure proof
recommendation.body: Accept the sticky lifecycle-failure behavior once a redacted Gateway transcript shows both endpoint families terminate as proposed.

likelyOwner.reason: The patch author supplied the protocol rationale and validation plan, making them the available routing contact in the supplied evidence.
